title: Sexual dimorphism in epidermal stem cell dynamics
title_zh: 表皮干细胞动力学的性别异质性
abstract: Abstract The epidermis is a stratified epithelium comprising proliferative basal cells and differentiated suprabasal cells that are continuously renewed throughout life. Conflicting theories have been proposed regarding the heterogeneity of the basal cell layer, with some studies proposing that all proliferative cells have self-renewal potential during homeostasis 1–5 . Meanwhile, others posit a model in which stem cell differentiation occurs through an intermediate transit-amplifying-like progenitor state with strictly limited proliferative potential 6–10 . Here, to determine the heterogeneity and pattern of cell fate, we performed intravital time-lapse imaging to track the fate of lineage-labelled cells in the skin interfollicular epidermis. Results from quantitative analyses of clonal dynamics support a two-compartment model of epidermal homeostasis, whereby basal cells are organized in a stem cell–transit-amplifying cell hierarchy. Critical to these conclusions was the discovery of sexual dimorphism in epidermal fate, with female mice showing a highly synchronized pattern of cell division, differentiation and delamination that contributes to accelerated wound healing. Single-cell RNA sequencing, transcriptional profiling and clonal analyses of castrated mice revealed that male sex hormones promote stem cell differentiation and delamination. In summary, our study provides insight into the functional identity of the stem cell population and identifies sex-specific differences in the regulation of epidermal stem cells and transit-amplifying cell fate.
abstract_zh: 摘要 表皮是一种分层上皮，由增殖基底细胞和分化的顶层细胞组成，贯穿一生持续更新。关于基底细胞层的异质性，已有冲突的理论提出，其中一些研究认为在稳态下所有增殖细胞都具有自我更新潜能 1–5 。与此同时，其他研究则提出一种模型，即干细胞分化通过中间的有限增殖潜能的转运放大前体状态进行 6–10 。为此，我们通过体内时间-lapse成像追踪标记细胞在皮肤无毛囊表皮中的命运，以确定细胞命运的异质性和模式。定量分析克隆动力学的结果支持表皮稳态的两层模型，即基底细胞按干细胞-转运放大细胞层级组织。这些结论的关键在于发现了表皮命运的性别异质性，雌性小鼠表现出高度同步的细胞分裂、分化和脱落模式，有助于加速伤口愈合。单细胞RNA测序、转录组分析和去势小鼠的克隆分析揭示，雄性激素促进干细胞分化和脱落。总之，本研究提供了干细胞功能身份的见解，并鉴定了表皮干细胞和转运放大细胞命运的性别特异性调节机制。
